==Trivia==
*[[Big Smoke]] and [[Ryder]] appear in the most artworks each, with both characters appearing in five artworks.
*An [https://i.imgur.com/3Ig2mFE.png unreleased set of playing cards] featuring the artworks of several characters from ''GTA III'', ''Vice City'', ''San Andreas'' and ''Liberty City Stories'' includes never before seen artworks of [[Eddie Pulaski]], Kendl Johnson (without Cesar) and [[Catalina]]. Curiously, Pulaski's artwork depicts the 'csplas1' model found in the game files.
